title: Where the Prevalence Comes From
scopeNote: This keeps the two stages where a description most visibly acquires object status: the threshold applied to a simulated population, and the instrument that decides who counts. The naming stage, the comparison set, the separate duration and interference rules and the institutional-hardening stage are in the longer version, and the synthesis names them.
summary: Five people describe something difficult. A line drawn across four hundred others gives the condition a prevalence, and a three-item questionnaire gives it a membership. Neither number was discovered, and no three items find all five people.
learningObjectives: Explain why a prevalence figure depends on where the threshold was set.
Explain why socially constructed does not mean made up.
Explain how an instrument decides who counts as a case.
Recognise that the features which sound most like a condition may distinguish least.
Say what stops being asked once a category has a name, a number and an instrument.
interactionTypes: a live threshold applied to four hundred simulated people
a distribution whose bars never change height while the shading does
a three-item questionnaire the learner assembles from six features
live detection of which of the original five the instrument still finds
a guided instrument built from the features that sound most like the condition
privacy: Nothing is collected, stored or transmitted. No questionnaire is administered to the reader and nothing is inferred about anybody.
dataStatus: The category, its features, its instrument and its prevalence are all invented for teaching. No real diagnosis, construct, published criteria set or published estimate is described or reproduced. The five accounts are fictional and the four hundred respondents are simulated.
accessibilityNotes: Keyboard operable throughout. The threshold is a native range input reporting its value in text, and the questionnaire items are native checkboxes; an item that will not fit is dimmed and described as not fitting rather than disabled, so it stays in the tab order, and an attempt to add a fourth is refused with a spoken reason. The five accounts, and which of them the instrument finds, are in real tables with row and column headers, with the verdict given in words as well as by a non-colour state attribute. The distribution's bars carry their counts as text and the chart description lists every bar, the line and the resulting prevalence. Nothing is timed and there is no motion.
simulationNotes: Four hundred respondents each have a latent load drawn from a standard normal, and feature f is present when a uniform draw falls under the logistic of its intercept plus its slope times that latent. The first two features have high intercepts and weak slopes, which is why they are the commonest and the least distinguishing, and why they are the ones that sound most like the condition. Nothing about the four hundred changes when the control moves: the bars in the figure keep their heights and only the shading moves, which the test suite checks by comparing the rendered heights at the extremes of the control. Prevalence runs from 82.3 per cent at two features to 6.3 per cent at six, more than a tenfold difference from a single chosen number. The five accounts are authored rather than simulated, and two of them are written to describe difficulty arising from hours and obligations rather than from anything inside the person. Somebody is found by an instrument when they would endorse at least two of its three items, and the activity's central fact is verified exhaustively over all twenty possible three-item instruments rather than asserted: none finds all five, the best manages four, only two of the twenty achieve that, and the obvious instrument finds three and misses exactly the two structural accounts. The best-possible figure quoted on the page is computed at load from the same data rather than written in, so the claim cannot drift. Simplifications, stated in the caution: the population has a single latent dimension, which is a strong assumption and is what makes the line look so plainly arbitrary; the two-of-three scoring rule is a crude stand-in for real scoring; and the naming and institutional stages are not present.
readmeTopic: how a description acquires a prevalence and a membership, neither of which was found
